title: Customize AI agent browsing with proxies, profiles, and extensions in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Browser
tldr: AWS introduced advanced customization options for AI agent browsing within Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Browser, including support for proxies, profiles, and browser extensions. tldr: AWS detailed the integration of Strands Agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to facilitate the deployment of long-running MCP (Multi-Computation Process) servers. tldr: Hugging Face introduced OpenEnv, a framework for robustly evaluating tool-using AI agents in diverse real-world environments. This initiative provides critical benchmarks and methodologies for assessing agent performance beyond synthetic tasks, pushing towards more reliable and capable autonomous systems.

title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano 30B MoE model is now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
tldr: AWS announced the NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano 30B MoE model is now accessible via Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, making this mixture-of-experts model readily available for developers. title: The Death of Traditional Testing: Agentic Development Broke a 50-Year-Old Field, JiTTesting Can Revive It
tldr: Meta AI's engineering blog discussed the paradigm shift in software testing caused by agentic development, challenging traditional methods. They propose JiTTesting (Just-in-Time Testing) as a novel approach to adapt and revive testing practices in the era of AI agents.

title: Mastering Amazon Bedrock throttling and service availability: A comprehensive guide
tldr: AWS published a comprehensive guide to mastering throttling and ensuring high service availability for applications built on Amazon Bedrock. title: Harness engineering: leveraging Codex in an agent-first world

title: How Amazon uses Amazon Nova models to automate operational readiness testing for new fulfillment centers
tldr: Amazon detailed its internal methodology for automating operational readiness testing in new fulfillment centers using their proprietary Nova models. title: R²D²: Scaling Multimodal Robot Learning with NVIDIA Isaac Lab
tldr: This post introduces R²D², a novel approach designed to scale multimodal robot learning by effectively integrating diverse sensory data and action spaces. title: Building real-time voice assistants with Amazon Nova Sonic compared to cascading architectures

title: The two patterns by which agents connect sandboxes
tldr: This post discusses two architectural patterns for connecting AI agents to external execution environments (sandboxes): "tool-first" where agents execute pre-defined functions, and "shell-first" where agents operate with direct command-line access. It analyzes the trade-offs in security, flexibility, and complexity for building robust agentic systems.

title: Automated Reasoning checks rewriting chatbot reference implementation
